description: Jump clones in a real EVE client: after the Augmentations tab has cached the implants, a clone jump (a swap in one station, a jump from the pod to another station, a swap from inside a ship) refreshes the cache and offers Plug In Implant again; a named clone keeps its name after being entered and left; a swap in one station neither waits for nor starts the cooldown, and a remote jump during it is refused. Needs the client-agent patch and a fresh world (the character must have no jump clones yet). Driver: jumpclone/jumpclone.py.

setup.note: leaves the AIR tutorial, which would ask Skip NPE? before the first jump
Infomorph Psychology V, docked, an Ocular Filter fitted, a clone installed here
Augmentations open, swap into the empty clone: cache clears, Plug In Implant offered, timer unchanged
the clone named Industry keeps its name after being entered and left
from the pod at another station: cache shows the new body's implants without a relog
from inside a ship: the Jump button unboards, the cache clears, timer unchanged
during the cooldown a jump to another station is refused

expect.note: the clone jump service raised nothing
nor did the skills service refreshing its implants
nor the character sheet's clone list
